title: Boundary compatibility for canonical augmentation quotients
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U_i$ an open cover, $0\to F_1\to F_2\to F_3\to0$ a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] surjective on sections over every tuple intersection, and $q\geq0$. Suppose $c:\check H^{q+1}(U,F_1)\to H^{q+1}(X,F_1)$ and $d:\check H^q(U,F_3)\to H^q(X,F_3)$ satisfy IsAbelianCechComparison [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction]. Then $c\circ\check\delta^q=\delta_H^q\circ d$. In particular the construction hypothesis, not degree-zero normalization alone, forces compatibility.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, augmented double complex; Tag 013T, horseshoe resolutions; Tag 0117, functorial homology sequence

proof.text: Choose horseshoe resolutions of the three sheaves. Their degreewise split exact sequence remains exact after sections, products, and finite-diagonal totalization. The assumed tuple surjectivity also makes the coefficient Čech sequence short exact.

Both sets of augmentations give morphisms of short exact complex sequences. Naturality of homology connecting maps yields the beta and alpha boundary squares. The constant-sheaf adjunction identifies the section boundary with the Ext boundary via the usual lift-differentiate-lift cocycle computation.
Apply the canonical quotient equations on these horseshoe resolutions. Cancel H(alpha) in degree q+1 and the canonical section/Ext identification.

theorem abelianCechComparison_boundary
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (T : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hT : T.ShortExact)
    (hg : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      Function.Surjective (T.g.hom.app (op (⨅ l, U (y l))))) (q : ℕ)
    (c : (TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyFunctor U (q + 1)).obj T.X₁ ⟶
      (Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (q + 1)).obj T.X₁)
    (d : (TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyFunctor U q).obj T.X₃ ⟶
      (Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) q).obj T.X₃)
    (hc : IsAbelianCechComparison U T.X₁ (q + 1) c)
    (hd : IsAbelianCechComparison U T.X₃ q d) :
    TopCat.Sheaf.cechδ U hT hg q ≫ c = d ≫ Sheaf.functorHδ hT q
